tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.energy: Cuts FE per operation to 0.8x each (Combustion Plant: +12.5% FE per fuel)
tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.heat: +12.5% heat per fuel or lava each (Thermoelectric Plant: better efficiency)

gui.arcforge.induction_array.power_hint: %s%% less FE per item than an Induction Furnace
gui.arcforge.pressing_array.lanes_hint: Lanes pressing; each lane uses its own die
gui.arcforge.pressing_array.power_hint: %s%% less FE per operation than a Metal Press
gui.arcforge.pressure.auto.hint: Boils all heat above 100°C, making whatever grade it's hot enough for
gui.arcforge.pressure.high_pressure.hint: Heats to 500°C without boiling, then holds there making High-Pressure Steam
gui.arcforge.pressure.superheated.hint: Heats to 900°C without boiling, then holds there making Superheated Steam
gui.arcforge.superheater.pressure.auto.h: Makes the best grade its heat allows
gui.arcforge.superheater.pressure.high_p: Turns Steam into High-Pressure from 500°C; passes the rest through
gui.arcforge.superheater.pressure.superh: Makes only Superheated Steam, from 900°C; colder, steam passes through
gui.arcforge.auto_eject.off.description: Outputs wait to be pulled out
gui.arcforge.auto_eject.on.description: Pushes outputs into adjacent blocks on Output faces and ports
tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.insulation: Cuts a Heat Cell's heat leak to 0.8x each
tooltip.arcforge.info.geothermal_plant: Makes heat from lava in its tank, and for free from lava (40 HU/t) and magma (16 HU/t) touching it. The hottest heat source, up to 1,400°C.
tooltip.arcforge.info.combustion_plant: Burns coal and charcoal straight into FE. Quick to set up, but a Firebox feeding a Thermoelectric Plant gets more from each coal. Charcoal sometimes leaves Wood Ash in its ash slot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.firebox: Burns coal and charcoal into heat (HU), up to 1,100°C. Feed it oxygen for oxy-fuel: 300°C hotter and 25% more heat per fuel. Push the heat into machines with Thermodynamic Conduits. Charcoal sometimes leaves Wood Ash in its ash slot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fuel_burner: Burns liquid fuels into heat, up to each fuel's burn temperature: creosote 850°C, Biodiesel 1,000°C, Biogas 1,100°C, Naphtha 1,200°C, Hydrogen 1,400°C. With oxygen (oxy-fuel) each burns 300°C hotter, up to 1,600°C, with 25% more heat per fuel.
tooltip.arcforge.info.thermoelectric_pla: Turns heat into FE. The hotter the heat it gets, the more FE it makes from each HU.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_boiler_array: Build a hollow 3x3 tower, 3 to 7 blocks tall, from these and Pressure Glass to make a Steam Boiler Array: it boils water into steam with heat, and the hotter it runs, the better the steam.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_turbine_arra: Build a hollow 3x3 tube, 3 to 9 blocks long, from these and Pressure Glass to make a Steam Turbine Array. Heavy Oil or Seed Oil lubricant adds output and spin-up. Give it an Exhaust port and spent steam leaves as Exhaust Steam for a Condenser Array, for +10% FE while it drains. Without one, it vents as before.
tooltip.arcforge.info.superheater_array_: Build a solid 3×3×3 cube. Takes steam and heat in and sends the next steam grade out, for 3 HU per mB per grade step (cheaper than boiling Superheated Steam directly). Its heat must be at least 500 °C for High-Pressure and 900 °C for Superheated; colder, steam passes through unchanged.
tooltip.arcforge.info.condenser_array_ca: Build a solid 3×3×3 cube. Turns Exhaust Steam from a Steam Turbine Array back into water, 1:1. 120 mB/t in open air; water sources and ice touching it cool it faster. Cold biomes help, the Nether hurts.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressure_glass: Windows for the Steam Boiler and Turbine Arrays: shows the water, steam or rotor inside. Any block but the corners can be glass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.electric_pump: Pumps the fluid source below it with FE and pushes it out of its top. Leaves infinite water pools in place.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_melter: Melts stone, netherrack and magma blocks into lava with FE. Pipe the lava out, or set a Geothermal Plant right under it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.chemical_reactor: Reacts up to two items and up to two fluids into an item and/or a fluid. Makes Sulfuric Acid, leaches raw ore into slurry, precipitates slurry into dust, and makes NPK Fertilizer, Nutrient Solution and Biodiesel.
tooltip.arcforge.info.sulfur_dust: Crushed from gunpowder, netherrack or Nether Sulfur Ore. The Chemical Reactor turns it into Sulfuric Acid.
tooltip.arcforge.info.sulfuric_acid_buck: Leaches raw ore into slurry in the Chemical Reactor. Burns anything that wades in.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_crusher: Crushes ores into dusts with FE, with a chance of a bonus output. Raw ores give extra dust.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_crushing_array: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane crusher that doubles ores.
tooltip.arcforge.info.induction_furnace: Smelts anything a furnace can, faster, with FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.induction_furnace_: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane Induction Furnace.
tooltip.arcforge.info.metal_press: Presses ingots into plates, gears and rods with FE. The die in its die slot decides what it makes.
tooltip.arcforge.info.metal_pressing_arr: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane Metal Press, each lane with its own die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fiberizer: Spins slag and basalt into mineral wool with FE and heat. Needs 800°C or hotter.
tooltip.arcforge.info.infuser: Soaks wood in creosote to make treated wood, using FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.carbonizer: Build a hollow chamber of these to bake coal or carbon dust into coal coke. Coal gives creosote as a by-product.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arcforge_furnace_b: Walls of the Arcforge Furnace, the multiblock that smelts steel and the tier alloys.
A decorative wall of Arcforge Furnace bricks.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arcforge_furnace_p: The front of the Arcforge Furnace: opens its GUI (metal, additive and coke slots) and takes items in and out.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_conduit: Carries FE between machines. Right-click a side with a Wrench to set it to input, output or off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.item_conduit: Carries items between inventories. Right-click a side with a Wrench to set it to input, output or off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fluid_conduit: Carries liquids (not gases) between tanks and machines. Holds one fluid at a time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressurized_condui: Carries gases like steam. Glows in the colour of the gas inside. Holds one gas at a time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.thermal_conduit: Carries heat (HU) from hot machines to cooler ones. Glows from dull red to white-hot with the heat inside.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fluid_tank: Stores one liquid. Keeps its contents when picked up with a Wrench. Its slots fill and empty buckets and Canisters.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressurized_cylind: Stores one gas, like steam. Keeps its gas when broken. Its slots fill and empty Gas Cartridges.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_cell: Stores FE. Keeps its charge when broken. Its slots charge and drain Batteries.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heat_cell: Stores heat (HU). Leaks slowly; better tiers and Insulation Upgrades leak less. Its slots fill and empty Thermal Capsules.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wrench: Shift+Scroll changes its mode: Configure (conduit sides, multiblock checks), Rotate (machines), Port (multiblock ports, machine faces) and Dismantle (pick up machines with their contents, take off Conduit Covers). Craft it early: new multiblocks need it to set their ports.
tooltip.arcforge.info.conduit_filter: Goes on a conduit connection to a machine (item, fluid or pressurized conduits) and decides what passes. Right-click the connection with an empty hand to set it up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.crate: A bigger chest. Set its faces to input or output in the Sides tab. Picked up with the Wrench, it keeps its items.
tooltip.arcforge.info.vault: Holds lots of one stackable item. Right-click the front to insert (twice quickly: insert all), left-click to take a stack (Shift: one). Keeps its contents when broken.
tooltip.arcforge.info.storage_upgrade: Upgrades a placed Crate or Vault of the tier below where it stands, keeping everything inside.
tooltip.arcforge.info.speed_upgrade: Makes a machine work faster, using power or fuel just as much faster.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_upgrade: Cuts the FE a machine uses per operation.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heat_upgrade: Gets more heat from each fuel, or more FE from each HU.
tooltip.arcforge.info.insulation_upgrade: Slows how fast a Heat Cell leaks heat.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_ingot: Made in the Arcforge Furnace from iron and coal coke. The backbone of Arcforge machines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_block: Nine steel ingots in a block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.coal_coke: Coal baked in a Carbonizer. Fuel for the Arcforge Furnace, and burns longer than coal.
tooltip.arcforge.info.coal_coke_block: Nine coal coke in a block. The Arcforge Furnace breaks it back open as fuel.
tooltip.arcforge.info.slag: A by-product of the Arcforge Furnace. Spin it into Slag Wool in a Fiberizer, or crush it into Basic Slag fertilizer in an Arc Crusher.
tooltip.arcforge.info.creosote_bucket: The Carbonizer's oily by-product. Treats wood in the Infuser, burns in the Fuel Burner (850°C) and distils into oils.
tooltip.arcforge.info.iron_dust: Crushed iron. Smelts into an iron ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_dust: Crushed copper. Smelts into a copper ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gold_dust: Crushed gold. Smelts into a gold ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.ancient_debris_dus: Crushed ancient debris. Smelts into netherite scrap.
tooltip.arcforge.info.carbon_dust: Crushed coal or charcoal. A furnace fuel, and bakes into coal coke in a Carbonizer (no creosote).
tooltip.arcforge.info.nether_quartz_dust: Crushed nether quartz. Smelts back into quartz.
tooltip.arcforge.info.slag_wool: Mineral wool spun from slag. Insulates the lower Heat Cell tiers.
tooltip.arcforge.info.rock_wool: Mineral wool spun from basalt. Insulates the better Heat Cells and makes Insulation Upgrades.
tooltip.arcforge.info.plate_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press plates. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gear_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press gears. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.rod_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press rods. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_plate: A pressed steel plate. Used in upgrades, steam machines and the bigger arrays.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_gear: A pressed steel gear. Used in turbines and moving machines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_rod: A pressed steel rod. Used in frames and Pressure Glass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_plate: A pressed copper plate. Used in Energy Upgrades and boilers.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_gear: A pressed copper gear. Used in the Electric Pump.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_rod: A pressed copper rod. Used in Pressurized Conduits and turbines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.silver_gear: A pressed silver gear, from 4 Silver Ingots with a Gear Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.silver_rod: A pressed silver rod: 1 Silver Ingot makes 2 with a Rod Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.nickel_gear: A pressed nickel gear, from 4 Nickel Ingots with a Gear Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.nickel_rod: A pressed nickel rod: 1 Nickel Ingot makes 2 with a Rod Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.tungsten_gear: A pressed tungsten gear, from 4 Tungsten Ingots with a Gear Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.tungsten_rod: A pressed tungsten rod: 1 Tungsten Ingot makes 2 with a Rod Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.invar_gear: A pressed invar gear, from 4 Invar Ingots with a Gear Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.invar_rod: A pressed invar rod: 1 Invar Ingot makes 2 with a Rod Die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_log: Wood soaked in creosote. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_wood: Wood soaked in creosote. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.stripped_treated_l: Treated wood with the bark stripped off. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.stripped_treated_w: Treated wood with the bark stripped off. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_planks: Planks of creosote-treated wood. Never catch fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_stairs: Treated wood stairs. Never catch fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_slab: A treated wood slab. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_fence: A treated wood fence. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_fence_gate: A treated wood fence gate. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_door: A treated wood door. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_trapdoor: A treated wood trapdoor. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_pressure_p: A treated wood pressure plate. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_button: A treated wood button. Never catches fire.

multiblock.arcforge.arc_crushing_array.r: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Arc Crushing Array Casings.
multiblock.arcforge.induction_furnace_ar: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Induction Furnace Array Casings.
multiblock.arcforge.metal_pressing_array: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Metal Pressing Array Casings.
multiblock.arcforge.carbonizer.rules: Slices side by side, all facing one way: each 2-3 tall and 2-3 deep, up to 8 slices.
multiblock.arcforge.arcforge_furnace.rul: 3x3, 6 tall: walls on the corners, bricks on the edges, the port at the front of the bottom layer.
multiblock.arcforge.steam_boiler_array.r: A hollow 3x3 tower, 3 to 7 tall. Corners must be casings; glass anywhere else.
A hollow 3x3 tube, 3 to 9 long. Corners must be casings; glass anywhere else.
multiblock.arcforge.superheater_array.ru: A solid 3×3×3 cube of 27 casings. Set ports with the Wrench (Port mode).
multiblock.arcforge.condenser_array.rule: A solid 3×3×3 cube of 27 casings. Set ports with the Wrench (Port mode).
jei.arcforge.multiblock.controls: Drag to turn · Scroll for layers
tooltip.arcforge.info.alloy: A tier material, made in the Arcforge Furnace. Every tiered block and item of this tier is made from it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.battery: Carries FE. Charge and drain it in an Energy Cell's slots.
tooltip.arcforge.info.canister: Carries one liquid. Fill and empty it in a Fluid Tank's slots. Won't take gases.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gas_cartridge: Carries one gas, like steam. Fill and empty it in a Pressurized Cylinder's slots.
tooltip.arcforge.info.thermal_capsule: Carries heat (HU). Fill and empty it in a Heat Cell's slots; heat only flows hot to cold. Leaks while carried.
gui.arcforge.lubricant.effect_spin_up: Effect: +%s%% output, x%s spin-up (when not empty)
multiblock.arcforge.distillation_array.r: A solid 2x2 column, 4, 6 or 8 tall, with one controller. Controller and trays not in the top or bottom layer.
tooltip.arcforge.info.distillation_array: Build a solid 2x2 column, 4, 6 or 8 tall, of these, Tray Level Casings and one Controller to distil creosote.
tooltip.arcforge.info.tray_level_casing: A window onto the Distillation Array's trays. Not in the top or bottom layer.
tooltip.arcforge.info.distillation_array: Runs the Distillation Array and opens its GUI. Its display faces the column's front. Not in the top or bottom layer.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pitch: The solid residue of distillation. A long-burning fuel; spins into Carbon Fiber and makes Asphalt.
tooltip.arcforge.info.carbon_fiber: Spun from pitch in a Fiberizer. Needed for Arcforged Alloy.
tooltip.arcforge.info.asphalt: A road surface: you walk, run and ride about 30% faster on it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.asphalt_slab: A road surface: you walk, run and ride about 30% faster on it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.asphalt_stairs: A road surface: you walk, run and ride about 30% faster on it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.naphtha_bucket: The lightest fraction of creosote. The hottest liquid Fuel Burner fuel (1,200°C). Catches fire in the world.
tooltip.arcforge.info.light_oil_bucket: A middle fraction of creosote, from an 8-high Distillation Array. Burns in the Fuel Burner at 1,000°C.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heavy_oil_bucket: The heavy fraction of creosote. A long-burning fuel (750°C) and a steam turbine lubricant.
tooltip.arcforge.wrench.configure: Right-click a conduit side to cycle it (Shift: backward), or a multiblock to check it
tooltip.arcforge.wrench.rotate: Right-click a machine to turn it (Shift: the other way)
tooltip.arcforge.wrench.port: Right-click a multiblock block or machine face to see its port; Shift+Right-click to change it
tooltip.arcforge.wrench.dismantle: Shift+Right-click to pick up a machine (with its contents), a conduit or a multiblock block
gui.arcforge.ports.hint: Use a Wrench in Port mode (Shift+Scroll) and Shift+Right-click a block
arcforge.multiblock.no_ports: No ports yet: use a Wrench in Port mode (Shift+Scroll) and Shift+Right-click an outer face.
gui.arcforge.solar.axis_hint: Set by the controller's facing: face it north or south for the best (north-south) axis.
gui.arcforge.solar.high_pressure: High-Pressure Steam needs %s°C: set the boiler's pressure to hold it there
A 2x2 tower 4 tall: 3 layers of casings with one outward-facing controller in the bottom, 4 collectors on top.
tooltip.arcforge.info.solar_thermal_arra: Build a 2x2 tower of three layers of these, with one Controller in the bottom layer and four Solar Collectors on top.
Runs the Solar Thermal Array. Must face out of the tower: north or south gives the best tracking axis.
tooltip.arcforge.info.solar_collector: The top layer of the Solar Thermal Array: each one in sunlight adds a quarter of its heat.
tooltip.arcforge.info.trough_mirror: A curved mirror for Solar Collectors.
tooltip.arcforge.info.receiver_tube: Sits at a trough mirror's focus and heats up in the sun.
tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.thermoelectric: +6.25% FE per HU each (Thermoelectric Plant only)
death.attack.arcforge.sulfuric_acid.play: %1$s dissolved in sulfuric acid while fighting %2$s
tooltip.arcforge.info.electrolyzer: Splits water into Hydrogen and Oxygen with FE: 1 mB of water makes 2 mB of hydrogen and 1 mB of oxygen. Hydrogen stores energy, it doesn't make it: burning it always returns less FE than it cost.
tooltip.arcforge.info.plastic_sheet: Made in the Chemical Reactor from Light Oil and Hydrogen.
gui.arcforge.electrolyzer.vent_on: On: when the tank is full, the extra is released and splitting carries on
gui.arcforge.electrolyzer.vent_off: Off: splitting stops while this tank is full
gui.arcforge.electrolyzer.cost.hint: FE per mB of hydrogen, after Energy upgrades. Never below %s FE, so hydrogen can't make free power.
tooltip.arcforge.info.assembler: Crafts any crafting recipe set in its 3×3 pattern from ingredients in its buffer, with FE. Leftovers such as empty buckets come out beside the result. Use JEI's + to fill the pattern.
tooltip.arcforge.info.block_breaker: Breaks the block in front of it into its own inventory with FE. No tool needed: it drops what the right tool would, and harder blocks take longer.
tooltip.arcforge.info.block_placer: Places the first block it can from its 9 slots in front of it, using a little FE for each.
tooltip.arcforge.info.vacuum_collector: Pulls up dropped items within its range (5 blocks, up to 9) into its buffer with FE. A Conduit Filter in its filter slot limits what it takes.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_quarry: Mines a square area layer by layer from the top, keeping only the blocks its filter picks. Needs a clear 3×3 space, 3 blocks tall. Set the area and filter in its settings, scan to preview, then start.
tooltip.arcforge.info.tungsten_drill_hea: A part for the Arc Quarry.
tooltip.arcforge.info.quarry_scanner: A part for the Arc Quarry.
message.arcforge.quarry.no_room: The Arc Quarry needs a clear 3×3 space, 3 blocks tall
gui.arcforge.quarry.reset: Reset: stop and start again from the top layer
gui.arcforge.quarry.silk_on: Silk Touch: on (%s FE per block)
gui.arcforge.quarry.silk_off: Silk Touch: off (%s FE per block)
gui.arcforge.quarry.replace_on: Replace mined blocks from the replace slot
gui.arcforge.quarry.show_area: Show the area in the world
gui.arcforge.quarry.scan: Scan: count matching blocks without mining
tooltip.arcforge.info.throttle_lever: An aircraft-style throttle with a redstone signal of 0-15. Look at it and scroll the mouse wheel, or right-click / sneak + right-click.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_hammer: Mines a 3×3 area facing the side you hit, one durability per block. Sneak to mine a single block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_excavator: Digs a 3×3 area facing the side you hit, one durability per block. Sneak to dig a single block.
tooltip.arcforge.area_tool.rules: Only blocks it is good against, no harder than the one you hit
tooltip.arcforge.info.jetpack: Worn in the chest slot. Holds one gas at a time: fill it in a Pressurized Cylinder slot, or click a Gas Cartridge onto it in your inventory. Steam, High-Pressure Steam, Superheated Steam and Hydrogen work; Hydrogen gives the most thrust for the least fuel. Press the Jetpack Mode key to switch Normal / Hover / Off. Smith a Steel Chestplate onto it for armor.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_drill: An electric pickaxe and shovel. It never breaks, but it needs FE: charge it in an Energy Cell or a Battery slot. About 50 FE per block, more for hard blocks and for each active module. Right-click in the air to install modules; sneak + scroll to switch them on and off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_saw: An electric axe that fells whole trunks. It never breaks, but it needs FE: charge it in an Energy Cell or a Battery slot. Sneak + right-click toggles Felling mode. Right-click in the air to install modules; sneak + scroll to switch them on and off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.area_module: Arc tools mine a 3×3 area facing the side you hit, 5×5 on an Arcforged tool. Same rules as the Steel Hammer. +25% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.silk_touch_module: Arc tools mine with Silk Touch. Can’t be active together with a Fortune module. +100% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fortune_i_module: Arc tools mine with Fortune I. Only one Fortune module and no Silk Touch at a time. +50% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fortune_ii_module: Arc tools mine with Fortune II. Only one Fortune module and no Silk Touch at a time. +100% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fortune_iii_module: Arc tools mine with Fortune III. Only one Fortune module and no Silk Touch at a time. +150% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.vein_module: Arc Drill: mining an ore takes up to 64 connected blocks of that ore. Arc Saw: Felling mode takes the whole tree. +25% FE per block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.speed_module: Arc tools dig 50% faster. +50% FE per block.
message.arcforge.jetpack.disabled: Jetpacks are disabled on this server
arcforge.configuration.arcToolReceive: Arc tool charge rate (FE/t, per tier)
multiblock.arcforge.gas_turbine_array.ru: A hollow 3x3 tube, 5 to 9 blocks long along a horizontal axis. Corners must be casings; the rest may be casings or Pressure Glass. One end is the intake and must have air in front of its centre; the other end is the exhaust.
tooltip.arcforge.settings_card.empty: Empty · Sneak-use on a machine to copy
tooltip.arcforge.settings_card.hint: Use on a %s to paste · Sneak-use in the air to clear
message.arcforge.settings_card.wrong_siz: These ports are for a %s long %s
message.arcforge.settings_card.nothing: This block has no settings to copy
gui.arcforge.security.owner_only: Only the owner can change this
gui.arcforge.security_terminal.disabled: Security is off on this server
tooltip.arcforge.foundry.set: Full set: fire immunity, safe on magma, 8 s of lava protection (60 s recharge)
jei.arcforge.gas_turbine.not_accepted: Not burned in the Gas Turbine
tooltip.arcforge.conduit_color: Sheath: %s · connects only to %s and unsheathed conduits
tooltip.arcforge.info.settings_card: Sneak-use on a machine, conduit, Vault or multiblock to copy its settings: sides or ports, redstone mode, auto-eject, filter settings, boiler pressure, Vault lock and void, and machine modes. Use it on another block of the same kind to paste. It never copies items, fluids or upgrades. Sneak-use in the air to clear it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.security_terminal: Edits your security profile: your default mode (Public, Trusted or Private) and your trusted players. Changes apply to all your machines at once, anywhere.
tooltip.arcforge.info.foundry_helmet: Each Foundry piece cuts fire and hot-block damage by 25%. The full suit makes you immune to fire and magma, and shields you from lava for 8 seconds, recharging 60 seconds after you leave it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.foundry_chestplate: Each Foundry piece cuts fire and hot-block damage by 25%. The full suit makes you immune to fire and magma, and shields you from lava for 8 seconds, recharging 60 seconds after you leave it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.foundry_leggings: Each Foundry piece cuts fire and hot-block damage by 25%. The full suit makes you immune to fire and magma, and shields you from lava for 8 seconds, recharging 60 seconds after you leave it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.foundry_boots: Each Foundry piece cuts fire and hot-block damage by 25%. The full suit makes you immune to fire and magma, and shields you from lava for 8 seconds, recharging 60 seconds after you leave it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fermenter: Ferments crops with water into Ethanol, sometimes leaving Bone Meal. Dried Hops in its additive slot add 20%. It gives off Carbon Dioxide through Gas Output faces. Ethanol burns in the Fuel Burner and the Gas Turbine Array.
tooltip.arcforge.info.ethanol_bucket: A light fuel: 300 HU per mB at up to 900°C in the Fuel Burner, and burned in the Gas Turbine Array.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gas_turbine_array_: Builds the Gas Turbine Array: a 3x3 tube 5 to 9 long that burns Naphtha, Light Oil, Ethanol or Hydrogen straight to FE. Its hot exhaust can feed a Steam Boiler Array.
tooltip.arcforge.info.turbine_blade_set: A component for Gas Turbine Array Casings.
tooltip.arcforge.info.combustor: A component for Gas Turbine Array Casings.
advancements.arcforge.root.title: Arcforge
advancements.arcforge.root.description: Read the Engineer's Handbook. Next: craft a Wrench from iron and copper.
advancements.arcforge.start.wrench.title: Hands-On
advancements.arcforge.start.wrench.descr: Craft a Wrench. Next: place a Firebox or a Combustion Plant.
Place a Firebox or a Combustion Plant. Next: store power in an Energy Cell.
Get an Energy Cell. Next: form a Carbonizer.
advancements.arcforge.steel.carbonizer.d: Form a Carbonizer, and set its ports with the Wrench. Next: bake Coal Coke.
advancements.arcforge.steel.coal_coke.de: Get Coal Coke. Next: form an Arcforge Furnace.
advancements.arcforge.steel.arcforge_fur: Form an Arcforge Furnace. Next: smelt iron with coke into steel.
Get a Steel Ingot. Next: steel tools and FE machines.
advancements.arcforge.processing.dust.de: Get any dust. Next: form a processing Array.
advancements.arcforge.processing.array.d: Form an Arc Crushing, Induction Furnace or Metal Pressing Array. Next: leach ore in a Chemical Reactor.
advancements.arcforge.processing.leached: Precipitate a dust from ore slurry: 3 dust per raw ore.
advancements.arcforge.steam.boiler.title: Head of Steam
advancements.arcforge.steam.boiler.descr: Form a Steam Boiler Array. Next: make Superheated Steam.
advancements.arcforge.steam.superheated_: Make Superheated Steam in a Superheater Array. Next: form a Condenser Array.
advancements.arcforge.steam.condenser.de: Form a Condenser Array. Next: a long Steam Turbine Array.
Get Naphtha from a Distillation Array. Next: an Electrolyzer.
advancements.arcforge.chemistry.electrol: Make Hydrogen or Oxygen in an Electrolyzer. Next: make Plastic.
Get a Plastic Sheet. Next: Conduit Filters and Storage Upgrades.
advancements.arcforge.gear.steel_tools.d: Get any steel tool. Next: a Jetpack.
advancements.arcforge.gear.jetpack.title: Liftoff
advancements.arcforge.gear.jetpack.descr: Get a Jetpack. Next: an Arcforged Arc Drill.
advancements.arcforge.challenge.nine_sta: Run a 9-long Steam Turbine Array at full speed.
advancements.arcforge.challenge.full_thr: Run a Gas Turbine Array at full speed on a signal of 15.
advancements.arcforge.challenge.white_he: Reach 1,600°C in a Fuel Burner or Firebox on oxy-fuel.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_meter: Passes FE from its left side to its right, up to 65,536 FE/t, and shows the rate on its screen. Set a threshold to output redstone above or below it; comparators read the rate.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heat_meter: Passes heat from its left side to its right, up to 3,200 HU/t, and shows the rate on its screen. Set a threshold to output redstone above or below it; comparators read the rate.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fluid_meter: Passes liquids (not gases) from its left side to its right, up to 12,800 mB/t, and shows the rate on its screen. Set a threshold to output redstone above or below it; comparators read the rate.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gas_meter: Passes gases from its left side to its right through Pressurized Conduits, up to 25,600 mB/t, and shows the rate on its screen. Set a threshold to output redstone above or below it; comparators read the rate.
tooltip.arcforge.info.chargepad: Charges the held, hotbar and worn FE items (Arc Drills, Arc Saws, Batteries) of anyone standing on it. Feed it FE through the port on its back.
tooltip.arcforge.info.conduit_cover: Right-click a conduit to encase it; the conduit keeps working. Right-click the cover with a full block to copy its look, sneak-right-click with an empty hand to clear it. The Wrench (Dismantle) takes it off.
gui.arcforge.meter.mode.above.tooltip: Signal while the rate is above the threshold
gui.arcforge.meter.mode.below.tooltip: Signal while the rate is below the threshold
gui.arcforge.oxy_fuel.tooltip: Oxy-fuel: +%s°C (up to %s°C), ×%s heat per fuel, %s mB/t oxygen
message.arcforge.cover.not_full_block: Only full, solid blocks can be copied
tooltip.arcforge.info.compost_bin: Drop in seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers or food scraps. Once it's full it makes Compost. Hoppers and conduits can fill it and pull the Compost out from underneath.
tooltip.arcforge.info.loam: Dirt worked with Compost. Till it with a hoe into Loam Farmland, which holds nutrients, stays moist twice as long and can't be trampled.
tooltip.arcforge.info.irrigated_loam_far: Loam Farmland with a copper water channel: always moist, with no water nearby. Holds nutrients like Loam Farmland and can't be trampled.
tooltip.arcforge.info.compost: Fertilizer: +2 nutrients on Loam Farmland. Made in a Compost Bin. Craft it with dirt into Loam.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wood_ash: Fertilizer: +3 nutrients on Loam Farmland. Left in the ash slot of a Firebox or Combustion Plant when charcoal burns.
tooltip.arcforge.info.basic_slag: Fertilizer: +3 nutrients on Loam Farmland. Crush Slag in an Arc Crusher to get two.
tooltip.arcforge.info.mixed_fertilizer: Fertilizer: +8 nutrients on Loam Farmland in one go. Crafted from Compost, Wood Ash and Basic Slag.
message.arcforge.loam_farmland.full: This soil already holds all the nutrients it can
advancements.arcforge.farming.compost.de: Get Compost from a Compost Bin.
Use a fertilizer on Loam Farmland.
advancements.arcforge.farming.mixed_fert: Craft Mixed Fertilizer from Compost, Wood Ash and Basic Slag.
tooltip.arcforge.info.flax_seeds: Plant on farmland or Loam Farmland. Grown flax gives Flax Fibre and more seeds. Also found wild in plains, and in grass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.flax_fibre: Craft one into String, or four into Linen.
tooltip.arcforge.info.rapeseeds: The oil crop: plant them on farmland or Loam Farmland to grow more. Also found wild in meadows and plains, and in grass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.sorghum_seeds: Plant on farmland or Loam Farmland. Grown sorghum gives Sorghum Stalks. Also found wild in savannas, and in grass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.sorghum_stalks: Makes more Ethanol in a Fermenter than any vanilla crop: 80 mB each.
tooltip.arcforge.info.hop_seeds: Use on a Trellis standing on farmland to plant a hop vine. Also found wild in forests, and in grass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.hop_cones: Picked from a hop vine on a Trellis. The vine stays and bears again.
tooltip.arcforge.info.trellis: Hops climb it. Stand it on farmland (a second one can go on top), then plant Hop Seeds in the bottom one. Use a vine with cones to pick them.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wild_flax: Wild flax, from the plains. Break it for Flax Seeds.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wild_rapeseed: Wild rapeseed, from meadows and plains. Break it for Rapeseeds.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wild_sorghum: Wild sorghum, from savannas. Break it for Sorghum Seeds.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wild_hops: Wild hops, from forests. Break it for Hop Seeds.
advancements.arcforge.farming.new_crop.d: Find Flax, Rapeseed, Sorghum or Hop seeds, in grass or on a wild plant.
advancements.arcforge.farming.hop_harves: Pick Hop Cones from a vine on a Trellis.
advancements.arcforge.farming.every_crop: Harvest Flax Fibre, Rapeseeds, Sorghum Stalks and Hop Cones.
tooltip.arcforge.info.planter: Plants seeds on the empty farmland in the 3x3 in front of it, including Hop Seeds into a bare Trellis. Runs once per redstone pulse, or every 5 seconds with no redstone attached. Use it with seeds to fill it; hoppers and conduits work too.
tooltip.arcforge.info.harvester: Harvests the ripe crops in the 3x3 in front of it, stores the drops and replants with their seeds. Picks Hop Cones without breaking the vine. Runs once per redstone pulse, or every 5 seconds with no redstone attached. Hoppers and conduits can pull the harvest out.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fertilizer_spreade: Holds fertilizer and tops up the Loam Farmland in the 5x5 around it whenever a block's nutrients run low.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_sprinkler: Feed it water from a pipe, tank or conduit (1 mB/t). Keeps farmland within 4 blocks moist and gives the crops on it a small growth bonus.
tooltip.arcforge.info.scarecrow: Mobs can't trample farmland within 9 blocks of it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.iron_sickle: Use on a crop to harvest and replant the ripe crops in a 3x3.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_sickle: Use on a crop to harvest and replant the ripe crops in a 3x3.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_scythe: Use on a crop to harvest and replant the ripe crops in a 5x5.
advancements.arcforge.farming.hands_free: Place a Planter and a Harvester.
message.arcforge.millstone.nothing: Put something to mill in first
gui.arcforge.mill.hint: Items put in go to the emptiest lane.
gui.arcforge.fermenter.co2_hint: Leaves through Gas Output faces; the rest goes into the air.
jei.arcforge.milling.cost: %s turns, or %s a lane in a Mill
tooltip.arcforge.info.millstone: Mills wheat into Flour, seeds into Seed Meal and bones into extra Bone Meal. Put the item in, then use it with an empty hand (or give it a redstone pulse) to turn the stone. Sneak-use to take what it made.
tooltip.arcforge.info.mill: The powered Millstone: three lanes, several times faster. Takes Speed and Energy upgrades.
tooltip.arcforge.info.oil_press: Presses Rapeseeds, Flax Seeds and other seeds into Seed Oil and Press Cake, with FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.seed_extractor: Threshes crops into extra seeds, for replanting and for the Oil Press, with FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.grain_dryer: Dries Hop Cones, wheat and sorghum with heat. Only works above 60°C; feed it heat through its heat face.
tooltip.arcforge.info.flour: Milled wheat. Smelt or smoke it into Bread.
tooltip.arcforge.info.seed_meal: Milled seeds. A light fertilizer: +1 nutrient on Loam Farmland.
tooltip.arcforge.info.press_cake: What's left of seeds after the Oil Press. The Compost Bin takes it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.dried_hops: Put in the Fermenter's additive slot for 20% more Ethanol, for 4 operations.
tooltip.arcforge.info.dried_grain: Dried wheat. Ferments in half the time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.dried_sorghum: Dried sorghum. Ferments in half the time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.seed_oil_bucket: Pressed from seeds in the Oil Press. Lubricates the Steam and Gas Turbine Arrays like Heavy Oil.
advancements.arcforge.farming.mill.title: Grist for the Mill
advancements.arcforge.farming.dried_hops: Dry Hop Cones into Dried Hops.
arcforge.configuration.carbonDioxidePerE: Carbon Dioxide per mB of Ethanol
tooltip.arcforge.info.air_separator: Separates air into Nitrogen and Oxygen with FE. Needs no input, and works anywhere but the End. Oxygen goes out of Oxygen faces, Nitrogen out of Gas Output faces.
tooltip.arcforge.info.haber_reactor: Makes Ammonia from Hydrogen and Nitrogen with FE and heat. Only works at 450°C or hotter: feed it heat through its heat face.
tooltip.arcforge.info.digester_casing: Build a solid 3x3x3 of these with a Biogas Digester Controller in the middle of one side to make a Biogas Digester.
tooltip.arcforge.info.biogas_digester_co: Runs the Biogas Digester and opens its GUI. Goes in the middle of one side of a solid 3x3x3 of Digester Casings, facing out.
tooltip.arcforge.info.npk_fertilizer: Adds 15 nutrients to Loam Farmland and enriches it: crops on it grow twice as fast until those nutrients run out. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
tooltip.arcforge.info.digestate: The Biogas Digester's by-product. A fertilizer: adds 4 nutrients to Loam Farmland.
tooltip.arcforge.info.nutrient_solution_: NPK Fertilizer dissolved in water, from the Chemical Reactor. It feeds the Hydroponic Cell.
tooltip.arcforge.info.biodiesel_bucket: Seed Oil and Ethanol, reacted in the Chemical Reactor. A Fuel Burner fuel: 320 HU per mB at up to 1,000°C.
gui.arcforge.air_separator.vent_hint: Made each operation. When one tank is full, that gas goes back into the air.
gui.arcforge.biogas_digester.lanes_hint: %s of %s lanes digesting. Each digests one item.
multiblock.arcforge.biogas_digester.rule: A solid 3x3x3 of Digester Casings with one controller in the middle of a side, facing out.
advancements.arcforge.farming.air_separa: Separate Nitrogen out of the air with an Air Separator.
advancements.arcforge.farming.ammonia.de: Make Ammonia in a Haber Reactor.
advancements.arcforge.farming.npk_fertil: Get NPK Fertilizer from the Chemical Reactor.
Make Biodiesel from Seed Oil and Ethanol.
tooltip.arcforge.info.glass_cloche: Grows a crop by itself, no power needed: give it a soil, a seed and water. The harvest drops out of the bottom. Fertilizer speeds it up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.grow_chamber: A lamp-lit farm that grows crops 3 times as fast as the Glass Cloche, with FE and water. Takes fertilizer, Speed and Energy upgrades.
tooltip.arcforge.info.hydroponic_cell: Grows crops 6 times as fast as the Glass Cloche, with FE and Nutrient Solution and no soil. Also grows saplings, flowers and Hops. Carbon Dioxide speeds it up more.
gui.arcforge.cloche.co2_bonus: Optional: grows faster while it has some
multiblock.arcforge.greenhouse.rules: 5x5 to 11x11, 4 to 8 tall. Frame edges; glass or frame walls and roof; beds or frame floor; the controller in a wall; lamps under the roof.
tooltip.arcforge.info.greenhouse_frame: The Greenhouse Array's steel frame: its edges, and any part of its walls, roof or floor. Frames on the outside can be ports.
tooltip.arcforge.info.greenhouse_control: Runs the Greenhouse Array and shows its climate. Goes in one of its walls, facing out.
tooltip.arcforge.info.planting_bed: Goes in the Greenhouse Array's floor. Right-click it with a soil, then a seed; the greenhouse grows, harvests and replants it.
tooltip.arcforge.info.grow_lamp: Hangs from the Greenhouse Array's roof. Lights the beds under it at night and without sky, using FE.
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.speed_detail: Base x warmth x nutrients x CO2, for each bed with light
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.nutrients.off: None: feed Nutrient Solution or fertilizer to grow faster
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.co2.off: None: pipe in Carbon Dioxide to grow faster
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.heat.off: No heat: it follows the weather outside
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.heat.blocked: Too cold and no heat: feed HU through a heat port
gui.arcforge.greenhouse.lamps.off: No Grow Lamps: crops only grow by day under the sky
jei.arcforge.greenhouse.faster: Faster with warmth, nutrients and CO2
advancements.arcforge.farming.greenhouse: Harvest a crop a Greenhouse Array grew under its Grow Lamps.
Harvest from a Greenhouse Array that's heated to the ideal temperature, fed nutrients and Carbon Dioxide, and has Grow Lamps.
arcforge.configuration.heatPerSurface: Heat per Tick per Wall Block
arcforge.configuration.lampEnergyPerTick: FE per Tick per Grow Lamp
